title: Masculine Defaults via Gendered Discourse in Podcasts and Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: The authors propose a twofold framework: first, extracting gender-correlated discourse words from podcast audio using topic modeling and a speech-based gender segmenter (Gendered Discourse Correlation Framework or GDCF); second, measuring the representation stability of these words in LLM contextual embeddings by swapping masculine and feminine discourse words in parallel sentences using a novel intrinsic metric (Discourse Word-Embedding Association Test or D-WEAT).
